answer: Distinct-endpoint payout escrow. Each identity must send a continuous heartbeat from a distinct network endpoint; earnings accrue in escrow and release only after one full epoch. If two identities share an endpoint or heartbeat schedule, both escrows freeze until resolved. An attacker pays a separate routable address, uptime, and one-epoch delay per clone. The island network test showed key farms failing on endpoint collisions. An opal flag marks frozen escrows. A nebula deployment receives no exemption.
